title: Commit the real reference deployment (compose + Caddyfile)
description: scripts/deploy-app.sh says the production compose file has deliberately diverged from the repo and is not synced, so the only working deployment definition lives on one server. The tracked docker-compose.courthive.yml is the pre-Postgres stack and Caddyfile.courthive only has an active :80 block. Jim supplies the live compose file, Caddyfile and the variable NAMES from the server .env; this item commits them with secrets replaced by ${VAR} references, deletes or archives the stale variants, and adds .env.example listing every variable the stack reads. The result is the starting point for the packaged deployment in Sprints 022 and 023.

recommended_model.name: Sonnet 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Small, careful file consolidation with no design decisions.

acceptance_criteria: A tracked compose file and Caddyfile match what production runs, with every secret and the domain expressed as ${VAR}
.env.example exists, lists every variable read by the app and the stack with a one-line description and safe placeholder, and contains no real value
The stale docker-compose.courthive.yml (LevelDB era) and docs/courthive_postgres_phase2c.docker-compose.courthive.yml are removed or moved under docs/archive/ with a note
APP_ENV=production is set in the reference compose so session cookies are Secure
scripts/deploy-app.sh no longer says compose has diverged; whether it syncs compose is stated explicitly
README/CLAUDE.md variable tables include MY_TENNIS_ENABLED, WRAPPED_ACCESS_PASSWORD, TEMPLATE_RELOAD and MIGRATE_ALLOW_DIRTY_FORCE

notes: The live files are on the server only; the agent must be handed copies by Jim - do not SSH to production to fetch them without his say-so.
docker-compose.yml's e2e service shares the production data volume (audit 1.5); give e2e its own volume while here.

testing_requirements: docker compose -f <reference file> config succeeds with only .env.example values filled in

context.user_story: As the operator, I want the deployment that actually runs to be in git so that it can be reproduced and packaged.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
